name: tendrel
description: A research graph + LLM wiki for Claude Code. Typed nodes (experiments, theories, decisions) with evidence lifecycles and dependency edges, kept as markdown in your repo. In-session setup via /tendrel:seed; SessionStart anomaly report; on-demand reconcile with opt-in autonomy (reconcile = ask or auto); /tendrel:reconcile, /tendrel:status, /tendrel:seed, /tendrel:lint, /tendrel:next, /tendrel:calibrate commands; deterministic read-only graph-integrity lint; forward planning that ends in a verdict (continue, conclude, or wait) backed by a deterministic pre-check, pre-registered experiment exits, and deferred items with reopen triggers; configurable verbosity and opt-in background execution for status; graph visualization in status.md.
